title: A Weather for the Interior
author: Quentin Ravensworth
blurb: Mara Vane, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
